verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at no-code automation. Notion markets agents that 'keep work moving 24/7' and has Custom Agents and Notion Skills (instruction pages for repeatable workflows), and its integration directory claims connections that 'automate workflows'. Most automation evidence, though, is developer-oriented: the REST API, webhooks and internal connections for 'custom automations' all require code, and one community user reports quickly hitting 'limits of what is possible automatically.' Missing for 10: documented no-code builder for multi-step automations (triggers, conditions, chained actions), PM-facing workflow configuration docs, hands-on corroboration that non-developers can build multi-step flows.
